name: SmartFactory
description: Smart Factory console. Place a Wireless Terminal and, without walking anywhere, browse every machine, resource node and collectible in the world by category - open any machine UI, pull its output, and teleport to any of them. Ships a pre-scanned map database (507 resource nodes: ore nodes, geysers and resource well cores) with purity filtering, milestone ordering and a built-in search box, plus a hub shortcut bar for the terminal, workbench, MAM, AWESOME store and Space Elevator. Modded buildings and modded nodes are grouped under their own mod name. Landing spots are always safe: in front of the building, never inside geometry or inside vehicles/flyers.
